claims.statement: Dover's own release (2026-07-22): CPC (Colder Products Company), a Dover company, calls itself 'a leading provider of quick disconnect couplings, fittings and connectors for thermal management (liquid cooling of electronics)' with an established 'UQD and LQ connector families' portfolio, and adds full-flow (non-valved) Everis DC fittings that 'can be integrated directly into cold plates or manifolds'. Supplier self-report (L8 weak); no customer named. Context in Dover's SEC filings: 2025 filings name 'thermal connectors used in liquid cooling of data centers' as a growth driver; the 2026 Q1/Q2 10-Qs no longer do.

source_doc.title: CPC Launches Everis DC Full-Flow Connectors for High-Performance AI Cooling（Dover／CPC 新聞稿）

sources.quote: CPC (Colder Products Company), part of PSG, a Dover company (NYSE: DOV), and a leading manufacturer of connection technologies used in liquid cooling of electronics, today announced the launch of the Everis® DC Series, a family of full-flow connectors designed to support the increasing thermal demands of artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing infrastructure.
Everis DC connectors expand CPC's established portfolio of liquid cooling solutions, including the UQD and LQ connector families.

CPC (Colder Products Company) is a leading provider of quick disconnect couplings, fittings and connectors for thermal management (liquid cooling of electronics), life sciences, biopharma, industrial and chemical handling markets.
Unlike traditional valved connectors, Everis DC Series fittings can be integrated directly into cold plates or manifolds for enhanced space utilization.
